name: Google Ads Transparency MCP: Competitor Ads
description: Competitor Google ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center by domain, advertiser ID, Transparency Center link or advertiser name: which ads are new, running or stopped, with first and last shown dates, format and ad links. Hosted Streamable HTTP via Apify (Apify OAuth or API token); open-source Node.js and Python stdio servers in the repo.
